This site brings together two threads of my work:

1. **New technical writing & paper notes** (here under **Blog** and [Publications](../../publications.qmd)), focusing on markerless motion capture, differentiable biomechanics, foundation models for clinical movement understanding, and precision rehabilitation.
2. **The [Build & Crash Archive](../../archive.qmd)** — 58 posts migrated from my 2010–2017 Blogspot covering open-source flight controllers (OpenPilot, Tau Labs, Sparky, Freedom), embedded hardware, CNC machining, and early EEG/EMG projects.

Writeups on upcoming papers will be posted here soon.
